Coyote Mesa Ranch House

Big-sky ranch house on 40 acres outside the town of Mesquite Flats. Watch the sunset from the porch swing, ride the trails with our neighbor's horses (by arrangement), and soak in the cedar hot tub after dark.

Sleeps 12 across five bedrooms and a bunkhouse.

Ranch amenities
Cedar hot tub
Horseshoe pit
Covered porch with swing
Full kitchen
Satellite Wi-Fi

Ranch rules
No hunting or firearms
Close every gate behind you, the cattle are curious
No smoking indoors

Check-in after 2 PM.
The gate code is 5590 and the house key is in the mailbox.
